newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA M1 FALLS 1.15 PCT, M2 UP 2.88 PCT IN WEEK.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA M1 FALLS 1.15 PCT, M2 UP 2.88 PCT IN WEEK.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply fell to 154.3 billion levs on November 15 from 156.1 billion levs on November 8 and M2 rose to 861.3 billion levs from 837.2 billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.

Total broad money rose 3.18 percent to 898.8 billion levs as lev-denominated broad money edged up 0.47 percent to 514.7 billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money rose 7.05 percent to 384.1 billion levs.
Hard currency-denominated deposits of companies and individuals totalled $1.338 billion on November 15, up $14 million from November 8.
Lev-denominated term deposits of companies and individuals inched up to 304.3 billion levs on November 15 from 301.5 billion levs a week earlier. -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
